title: lyonia villosa var. sphaerantha
intro: Lyonia villosa var. sphaerantha, commonly known as Red-fruited Lyonia, is a plant species in the family Ericaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, sore throats, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Lyonia villosa var. sphaerantha include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
